Koksijde

Sunday 20 December 2026

The dunes of Koksijde are the setting for the fifth round of the UCI Cyclo-cross World Cup on Sunday 20 December. Koksijde is regarded as the ultimate sand event in cyclo-cross. Lucinda Brand and Mathieu van der Poel added their names to the honorary list last year. Which sand specialists will excel on the coast this time?

Tickets

Would you like to join us in Koksijde on Sunday 20 December? Click the button below and order your tickets now!

Ticket prices:

Presale: €20.50 (service fee included)

On race day, both at the on-site ticket office and online: €25.50 (service fee included)

Children born in 2015 or later can enter for free and do not need a ticket.

 

[GO TO THE TICKET SHOP](https://koksijde.tickets.ucicyclocrossworldcup.com/selection?language=en)
